power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.desc: Ndị na-akpụ akpụ na-atụ gị egwu ma ha agaghị abịaru nso.
power.neoorigins.feline_water_weakness.d: Na-ewe mmebi 0,5 kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo - ajị mmiri mmiri bụ nhụsianya.
power.neoorigins.feline_hunger_drain.des: Na-ere ọkụ 30% ngwa ngwa karịa mmadụ.
origins.neoorigins.golem.name: Golem
origins.neoorigins.golem.description: A na-eje ije ebe e wusiri ike nke ígwè na uche - fọrọ nke nta ikwaghari, ma ngwa ngwa na ngwangwa okpomọkụ.
power.neoorigins.golem_natural_armor.des: Mgbochi na-adịgide adịgide nke Mbụ - ikwasa ígwè na-ewepụ ihe ọfụfụ ọbụna mgbe ọ na-akwadoghị ya.
power.neoorigins.golem_size.name: Frame elu
power.neoorigins.golem_size.description: Bụ 30% buru ibu karịa onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.golem_fire_weakness.des: Na-enweta mmebi 80% karịa site na ọkụ, lava na magma ngọngọ kọntaktị - ígwè na-eduzi okpomọkụ.
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.name: Ọgba aghara
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.description: Zụlite n'ime ọchịchịrị miri emi - eri raw nkume, chews site ore na iferi aka, ma akpọnwụ na ìhè anyanwụ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.d: Anya na-adaba na ọchịchịrị miri emi - ọ dịghị mkpa ọwa. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.caveborn_no_fall_damage: Ọ maara ka esi ada n'ala na-enweghị isi. Anaghị emebi ọdịda ọdịda.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_speed.d: Na-agbaji ihe mgbochi niile ugboro abụọ ọsọ ọsọ - nkume ahụ na-ebute aka ndị maara nke ọma.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_stone_fists.de: Aka efu m dị ka nkume pickaxe - gbajie ores na nkume na-enweghị ngwaọrụ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_fortune: Mgbe Luck na-arụsi ọrụ ike (nke enyere site na iri diamond), ihe mgbochi ore na-ada dị ka a ga-asị na ejiri Fortune II gwuo ya.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.name: Onye na-eri nkume
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.desc: Nwere ike iri okwute, okwute, granite, diorite, andesite, tuff, deepslate, cobbled deepslate, basalt, na blackstone maka nri kwesịrị ekwesị. Agaghị agbada na afọ zuru oke.
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.name: Nri fungal
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.desc: Warped na crimson fungi bụ nri kwesịrị ekwesị na Nether - pịa nri iji rie maka agụụ 5 na saturation 0.6. Agaghị agbada na afọ zuru oke.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_copper.des: Nwere ike iri ingots ọla kọpa, ọla kọpa raw, ọla kọpa, ọla kọpa miri emi, na ihe mgbochi ọla kọpa raw - nri dị mfe n'etiti nkume na ígwè. Agaghị agbada na afọ zuru oke.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.name: Ọkpụkpụ ígwè
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.descr: Nwere ike iri nri iron, igwe anaghị agba nchara, eriri igwe, ọla kọpa, iron iron, na ihe mgbochi ígwè - nri kwesịrị ekwesị maka onye na-egwuputa ihe. Agaghị agbada na afọ zuru oke.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.name: Palate dị ọcha
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.descr: Nwere ike iri mgbịrịgba ọla edo, ọla edo na-akwọ mụrụmụrụ, mkpọ ọla edo, ọla edo, ọla edo dị omimi, ọla edo edo edo, na ihe mgbochi ọla edo - ihe oriri ka ukwuu. Agaghị agbada na afọ zuru oke.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_diamond.de: Nwere ike iri ola diamond, ọla diamond na ọla diamond deepslate - nke tụnyere karọt ọla edo na saturation. Agaghị agbada na afọ zuru oke.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_emerald.de: Nwere ike iri emerald, emerald ore, na deepslate emerald ore - nri kacha baa ọgaranya nke netherite. Agaghị agbada na afọ zuru oke.
Nwere ike iri netherite ingots, scrap na oge ochie irighiri ihe - nri kasị baa ọgaranya n'ụwa. Agaghị agbada na afọ zuru oke.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_copper_bonus.d: Iri ọla kọpa na-enye ume iku ume I maka sekọnd 60.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.des: Iri ígwè na-enye Haste I maka sekọnd 60.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_gold_bonus.des: Iri ọla edo na-enye ohere ọsọ I maka nkeji abụọ.
Iri diamond na-enye Luck II maka nkeji 5 - na-enyere Mining Fortune aka mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ.
Iri emerald na-enye mgbanaka ọkụ maka nkeji 5 - ìhè anyanwụ ka na-amụnye gị ọkụ, mana ọ nweghịzị ike ịgba gị ọkụ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_netherite_bonu: Iri netherite na-enye Ike I na Nguzogide I maka nkeji 5.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_daylight_damag: Na-enweta ọkụ ma na-emebi 1 kwa nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-enwu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_small_frame.de: 85% nha nke onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị - ọwara siri ike dị mfe.
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.name: Sylvan
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.description: A mmụọ nke ochie ọhịa - ngwa ngwa n'etiti osisi, hụrụ n'anya anụ ọhịa, na ike entangle ndị iro na a mịrị nke mgbọrọgwụ. Mmiri ozuzo gwọrọ, ma Nether chagburu.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.name: Onye nwere okike
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.desc: Ndị na-eme ihe ike na-ahapụ gị naanị - ha na-emegwara ma ọ bụrụ na i buru ụzọ tie.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.d: Ji nwayọọ nwayọọ na-agwọ ọrịa mgbe ị na-akpakọrịta na mmiri.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_forest_speed.des: Na-enweta nkwalite ọsọ ọsọ mgbe ọ nọ na biomes ọhịa.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.de: Na-emebi 1 kwa nkeji mgbe ọ nọ na Nether biomes. Akpụkpọ ụkwụ Frost Walker na-egbochi mmebi ahụ kpamkpam.
origins.neoorigins.draconic.name: Draconic
origins.neoorigins.draconic.description: Ọbara dragọn na-atụ egwu - ọkụ anaghị egbochi ya na anụ ọhịa na-atụ egwu, mana ire ọkụ na-ere ọkụ ngwa ngwa.
Na-egbochi ọkụ, lava, magma, na ọkụ - dragọn-ọbara na-agba ọkụ.
Na-egwu mmiri site na lava dị mfe ka ndị ọzọ na-egwu mmiri n'ime mmiri.
power.neoorigins.draconic_lava_vision.de: Na-ahụ n'ụzọ doro anya site na lava, free nke foogu na ọkụ haze - gbazee ogbu mmiri na-ezo ihe ọ bụla.
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.name: Wing Kushion
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.desc: Nku vestigial na-agbaji ọdịda gị - anaghị emebi ọdịda ọdịda.
power.neoorigins.draconic_scare_mobs.des: Ọtụtụ ihe e kere eke na-agafe agafe - anụ ụlọ, ndị obodo, anụ ọhịa - gbanarị ọnụnọ gị dị egwu.
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.name: Na-amanye Ogo
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.descripti: 20% buru ibu karịa onye ọkpụkpọ nkịtị - siri ike ileghara anya.
power.neoorigins.draconic_water_weakness: Na-ewere mmebi 1.5 kwa nkeji na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo - ọkụ kwesịrị iku ume.
power.neoorigins.draconic_hunger_drain.d: Na-agba ume 50% ngwa ngwa - ire ọkụ na-ere ọkụ.
origins.neoorigins.revenant.name: Nnabata
origins.neoorigins.revenant.description: Onye na-awagharị adịghị anwụ anwụ bụ onye na-esi n'ihe na-eme ihe ma na-atụba bolts nke ire ere - enweghị ike imikpu wee hụ n'ọchịchịrị, kama ọ na-agwọ ọrịa nwayọọ nwayọọ ma na-ere ọkụ na ìhè anyanwụ.
power.neoorigins.revenant_entity_group.d: Nkewa dị ka anwụghị anwụ. Ahụ ike ozugbo merụọ ya, mmerụ ngwa ngwa gwọọ ya, nsi anaghị emetụta ya.
power.neoorigins.revenant_water_breathin: Ọ dịghị mkpa iku ume. Nwere ike ịdị ndụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi n'okpuru mmiri.
power.neoorigins.revenant_night_vision.d: Enwere ike ịhụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.revenant_daylight_damag: Na-enweta ọkụ ma na-emebi 2 kwa nkeji mgbe ìhè anyanwụ na-enwu.
power.neoorigins.revenant_slow_regen.des: A na-ebelata nrụpụta ahụike eke ka ọ bụrụ 40% nke nkịtị.
origins.neoorigins.tiny.name: Obere
origins.neoorigins.tiny.description: Obere n'ogo mana ngwa ngwa na nimble - na-arịgo ihe ọ bụla, na-adọta ihe, mana ọ na-akụ dị ka nku.
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.name: Nke dị ntakịrị
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.name: Njide elu
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.desc: Nwere ike tụọ mgbidi ọ bụla n'ụzọ dị mfe.
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.name: Scurry
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.descri: Na-eme 20% ngwa ngwa karịa mmadụ nkịtị.
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.des: Obere nke na ịda ada adịghị mkpa. Anaghị emebi ọdịda ọdịda.
power.neoorigins.tiny_item_magnetism.des: A na-adọta ihe site n'ebe dị anya karịa.
power.neoorigins.tiny_attack_penalty.des: Na-eweta mmebi dị obere 2 kwa otu.
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.name: Obere afọ
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.descr: Agụụ na-agụ 80% ngwa ngwa - obere ahụ na-ere nri ngwa ngwa.
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.name: Dragọn ọgba
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.descripti: Dragọn nke ọkụ na nkume, nke a mụrụ n'ime ala n'okpuru ụwa. Ọ na-eme nke ọma na okpomọkụ na ọchịchịrị, ma na-etolite n'ime ike ya zuru oke ka oge na-aga.
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.name: Ụdị Dragọn Ọgba
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.descri: Were udi nke dragọn ọgbara - ihe okike nke magma na onyinyo. Ịlanahụ dragọn gị na-achịkwa àgwà dragọn gị, uto na ikike gị.
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.name: Dragọn ọhịa
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.descrip: Dragọn nke mgbọrọgwụ na ogwu, n'ụlọ n'etiti osisi oge ochie. N'ịbụ onye na-enwe ndidi na nke siri ike, ọ na-esiwanye ike ka ọ na-etolite.
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.name: Ụdị Dragọn ọhịa
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.desc: Were udi nke dragọn ọhịa - ihe e kere eke nke osisi vaịn na venom. Ịlanahụ dragọn gị na-achịkwa àgwà dragọn gị, uto na ikike gị.
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.name: Dragọn Oké Osimiri
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.descriptio: Dragọn nke ebili mmiri na oké ifufe, nke a mụrụ na mmiri mepere emepe. Ngwa ngwa n'okpuru ebili mmiri, ọ na-abịa n'ike ya na afọ.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.name: Ụdị Dragọn Oké Osimiri
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.descrip: Were udi nke dragọn oké osimiri - ihe e kere eke nke ugbu a na àmụmà. Ịlanahụ dragọn gị na-achịkwa àgwà dragọn gị, uto na ikike gị.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_apex_hp.name: Leviathan
